hook_text: More than five thousand objects, and every one tells a story.
clip_script: Stellenbosch, Western Cape. A classroom museum of replicas from Tutankhamun's tomb. A golden mask: the pharaoh's wealth. Tiny figures called shabtis: workers for the afterlife. Four little jars: mummification. Blue lapis lazuli from distant Afghanistan: trade. A board game, sandals and walking sticks: daily life. A lock of his grandmother's hair: family. And a dagger made from a meteorite. The tomb is a library without words.
visual_style: Whiteboard museum labels popping up next to each object, sorted into afterlife, wealth, trade and daily life.
mood: Fascinated and proud, like a museum tour.
pacing: One object at a time, then the big picture.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a label for one object from the tomb.
